description: Node's publish/subscribe class from `node:events`: `on`, `once`, `off`, `emit`. Listeners run **synchronously** in registration order.
Special event: when it is emitted with no listener, the emitter **throws** the error, which usually crashes the process.
`class X extends EventEmitter<{ paid: [Payment] }>`: the event map types the arguments of `on` and `emit`.
`await once(emitter, 'name')` resolves with the array of arguments of the next event and rejects if `'error'` fires first.
Listeners added repeatedly and never removed keep memory alive. Node warns with `MaxListenersExceededWarning` after 10 per event.
Returning `() => emitter.off(name, listener)` from a subscribe helper, like a React effect cleanup.
